title: gatewatch: constitution added without explicit human review
description: Evidence: commit e6c2e6a04c5c66dc9bfdb9eb00b4786dfb59442d; path docs/CONSTITUTION.md, lines 1-142 (added in the commit). Article IX requires changes to docs/CONSTITUTION.md to have explicit human review and forbids them from riding an auto-merged PR. The commit metadata/message contains no human-review or tracker sign-off evidence; it merged the protected mandate file.

title: gatewatch: title claims automated workflows absent from diff
description: Evidence: commit e6c2e6a04c5c66dc9bfdb9eb00b4786dfb59442d; git show --stat reports only docs/CONSTITUTION.md (142 insertions), while subject says 'chore(governance): standardize CONSTITUTION.md and automated workflows'. No workflow or automation file changed. Article I requires commit/PR titles and descriptions to describe their diff; the subject claims automated-workflow work not present in the diff.
